name: wp-fbclid-only-organic-facebook

quirk_decision: RULED DIFF standing (Hugo gate D2, 2026-08-23): bare fbclid is now classified source=facebook / channel=unknown / label 'Facebook' (paid status unknown). Plugin said 'Facebook Organic'; pre-D2 engine said 'Facebook Ads' — both were over-certain. Legacy plugin label available via legacyWordPressChannelLabel() only.
